table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:'+LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END, 
         aliasname=item.customicode,   
         packingdesc=max(item.packingdesc),   
         accname = max(dbo.accounts.name),   
         address =max( dbo.customer.address1),   
         address2= max(dbo.customer.address2),   
         city= max(dbo.customer.city),
         licenceno= max(dbo.customer.licenceno),   
         username= dbo.users.username,   
         saleinvcode = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
         headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,   
         date = Case :ai_printdate When 1 Then max(dbo.saleledger.originaldate) When 2 Then max(dbo.saleledger.date) When 3 Then max(dbo.saleledger.Billingdate)  End, 
         invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
         misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         flatdisc = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax = dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
         
         icode = saledetail.icode,   
         batch = max(saledetail.batch),   
         expiry = min(saledetail.expiry),   
         looseqty =sum( saledetail.looseqty),   
         bonusqty = sum(saledetail.bonusqty),   
         packqty = sum(saledetail.packqty),   
         packunits=max( saledetail.packunits),   
         saleprice= max(saledetail.saleprice),   
         discperc = max(saledetail.discperc),   
         itemflatdisc=max(saledetail.itemflatdisc),   
         Id = max(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL),   
         posted=max(saleledger.posted),   
         balance=0,   
         unitsalestax = saledetail.unitsalestax,   
         gstperc = saledetail.gstperc,   
         invgstperc = max(saleledger.invgstperc1),   
         custTaxRegno=max(customer.salestaxregno)  ,
		custref=max(dbo.saleledger.custrefno),	
		dbo.saleledger.remarks,
		printwaranty=max(dbo.saleledger.printwaranty),
		printbatch=max(dbo.saleledger.printbatch),
		salesman=(SELECT salesman.name FROM Salesman WHERE salesman.salesmancode=dbo.saleledger.smancode),
		Message=(SELECT Message.description FROM Message WHERE Message.Messagecode=dbo.saleledger.messagecode),
		CUSTALIAS=max(ACCOUNTS.ALIASNAME)

    FROM saleledger,   
         saledetail,   
         accounts,   
         customer,   
         users,   
         item  

   WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode between :ar_SInvCode and :ar_linvcode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.custcode IN (:ar_custcode) )AND 
			( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode) AND 
			( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    

GROUP BY saleledger.saleinvcode, 
			saleledger.date, 
			saleledger.custcode, 
			saleledger.discperc, 
			saleledger.flatdisc, 
			saleledger.misccharges, 
			saleledger.headerno,
			saleledger.salestax, 
			saleledger.remarks, 
			saleledger.smancode,
			saleledger.messagecode,
			saledetail.icode, 
/*			saledetail.rowgroup,*/
			saledetail.saleprice,
			saledetail.itemflatdisc,
			saledetail.discperc,
			saledetail.gstperc,
			saledetail.unitsalestax,
			item.name,
			item.icode,
			item.printable,
			item.customicode,
			users.username
ORDER BY dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode,
			max(dbo.saledetail.IDENTITYCOL)

objects.name: t_11
objects.visible: 1	if (sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1) > 0, 1, 0)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.visible: 1	if (sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1) > 0, 1, 0)
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  (saleprice  - itemflatdisc) )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )  for group 1)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round ( Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)*/Round(Sum (  c_netamount for group 1) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for group 1 ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for group 1)  *  (1 - discperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)
